payload.headline: Late-night boba, handed to you in your dorm lobby
payload.html:
Prototype · Waitlist open

Late-night boba, handed to you in your dorm lobby

A proposed boba delivery run for UCLA Hill residents — aimed at the 10pm to 2am window when every Westwood shop has already locked up.

Join the prototype waitlist

This is a concept page, not a live service. Nothing is operating yet — we are testing whether the late-night demand is real before a single drink is poured.

Why this is even a question

Westwood has plenty of boba. What it does not have is boba at the hour students actually want it.

Open when the shops are not

Research found no Westwood boba shop reliably serving past midnight, and only one open late on Friday and Saturday. The proposed run covers roughly 10pm to 2am, seven nights a week.

Lobby handoff, not a street address

Hill residents have to sign guests in at the access desk between 9pm and 5am. Delivery is proposed to meet you at the front desk, so you never walk down to Gayley at 1am.

Priced like the shops, not like a premium

Neighbourhood milk teas run about $6.25 to $8.15. Proposed pricing sits inside that band, with the late-night run and lobby handoff folded into one flat delivery fee.

How a run would work

  1. Order before the cutoff

    Orders are proposed to close at 1:30am so the last lobby drop happens by 2am. You pick a drink, a sweetness level, and your dorm.

  2. We batch one pickup run

    Instead of one rider per order, a single run collects a batch of drinks from a Westwood shop and heads up to the Hill — which is what keeps the delivery fee low.

  3. Meet at your access desk

    You get a message when the run is close and collect your drink at the lobby front desk. No room deliveries, matching UCLA's guest sign-in rules.

Proposed pricing

Every number below is a proposal for the prototype, benchmarked against Westwood menu prices — not a live rate card.

Single

One drink

$7.25 + $2.50 delivery

  • One milk tea or fruit tea
  • Toppings included
  • Lobby handoff
Most likely

Study group of 3

$6.75 per drink, delivery split

  • Three drinks in one order
  • Delivery fee divided three ways
  • One lobby pickup for the group
Floor party

Five or more

$6.50 per drink, free delivery

  • Five-drink minimum
  • No delivery fee
  • Proposed 20-minute order window ahead of the run

Benchmarks: Just Boba lists a $6.25 Thai milk tea and a $6.50 classic milk tea; Le Phant lists $8.15 per milk tea. Prices shown are prototype proposals, subject to change.

Proposed hours & service area

Two operational details we would still need to confirm with a partner shop and with UCLA Housing.

Hours

Proposed: 10pm to 2am nightly, orders close 1:30am. Not confirmed with any shop yet.

Service area

Proposed: UCLA Hill residence halls first, then nearby Westwood apartments along Gayley and Landfair. Not yet confirmed.

Handoff

Proposed: lobby front desk only, per the 9pm-5am guest sign-in rule. Room delivery is not planned.

Menu sketch

A deliberately short list — a late-night run only works if the batch is simple.

Classic milk tea

$6.50 black tea, milk, tapioca

Thai milk tea

$6.25 spiced, sweet, no topping needed

Matcha latte

$7.25 for the people avoiding caffeine

Prototype menu. Fruit teas, popping boba and custom sweetness levels are the first things we would add if the waitlist is big enough.

Questions students actually ask

Is this running right now?

No. This is a prototype concept page and a waitlist. No orders are being taken, no drinks are being delivered, and no shop partnership is in place. We are measuring interest first.

Why can't you just deliver to my room?

UCLA on-campus housing rules require guests to be signed in at an access desk between 9pm and 5am. A lobby handoff at the front desk is the only workable late-night option, and it is also faster for a batch run.

What would the delivery fee actually be?

The proposal is a flat $2.50 per order, waived at five drinks, and split when a group orders together. That is a proposal, not a confirmed rate — the real number depends on what a partner shop charges for a late batch.

Get on the prototype waitlist

Leave your email and tell us nothing else for now. If enough people sign up, the next step is talking to a Westwood shop about a real late-night run.

Prototype waitlist / contact form. Submitting opens your email client and sends a message to the team running this concept. No data is stored on this page, and this is not a purchase.

Prototype · Westwood late night

Boba delivered to your dorm lobby at 1am

A late-night boba run built for UCLA Hill residents, with a lobby handoff instead of a walk down to Gayley.

Join the prototype waitlist

This page is a concept preview. Midnight Boba is not operating yet — hours, pricing and service areas below are proposals open to feedback.

Why it exists

Westwood goes quiet before the craving does

Research on nearby shops shows the closest boba to campus closes around 11pm on weeknights, and the Hill requires every guest to be signed in at an access desk between 9pm and 5am. That leaves a real gap after midnight.

Open when others are not

No Westwood boba shop reliably serves past midnight. A proposed 8pm–2am window targets the hours students told us they actually order.

Lobby handoff, not street drop

UCLA housing rules require guests to be signed in at access desks after 9pm, so we meet you in the lobby — never at your room door.

Group-friendly by design

Orders are built for the 2–4 person study or post-party group, so one delivery covers the whole room instead of four separate trips.

How it works

Three steps from craving to lobby

1

Order ahead

Pick your drinks and a lobby window on the proposed 8pm–2am schedule.

2

We text an ETA

You get a heads-up before the runner leaves, so you can head down with your group.

3

Meet in the lobby

Collect your order at the access desk area — signed in and above board with housing rules.

Proposed menu & pricing

Priced to match Westwood, not to undercut it

Research put nearby milk teas between $6.25 and $8.15. These prototype tiers sit inside that band and include the delivery run.

$6.75 / drink

Single cup
  • One 24oz milk tea or fruit tea
  • Standard toppings included
  • Lobby handoff
Best for groups

$6.25 / drink

Four-cup study pack
  • Four drinks, one delivery
  • Lowest per-drink price
  • Built for 2–4 person rooms

$8.15 / drink

Premium build
  • Brown sugar or taro specialty
  • Extra topping included
  • Matched to premium Westwood pricing

Proposed menu

Classic milk teaBlack tea, milk, tapioca$6.25–$6.75
Brown sugar boba milkCaramelised syrup, fresh boba$8.15
Taro milk teaReal taro, creamy base$8.15
Passion fruit green teaCaffeine-light, fruit-forward$6.75

Menu and prices are proposals for the pilot and will change once supply costs are confirmed.

Proposed service area & hours

Where and when we would run

These are the areas the pilot is scoped for. Nothing is confirmed until the waitlist tells us where demand actually is.

  • De Neve Plaza
  • Rieber Hall
  • Sproul Hall
  • Hedrick Summit
  • Olympic Hall
  • Saxon Suites
  • Westwood apartments near Gayley
  • Sunday–Thursday8:00pm – 1:00am (proposed)
  • Friday–Saturday8:00pm – 2:00am (proposed)
  • Finals weekExtended to 3:00am (proposed)

Hours are a starting proposal, not a published schedule. They shift with demand and staffing.

FAQ

Questions students actually asked

Is this service running right now?

No. This is a prototype landing page collecting interest before launch. Every price, hour and service area shown is a proposal, and no orders are being accepted yet.

How does the dorm lobby handoff work with UCLA rules?

UCLA on-campus housing requires guests to be signed in at an access desk between 9pm and 5am. The proposed model has the runner wait in the lobby area so you sign them in at the desk and collect your order there, rather than meeting at your room.

Why is there a four-cup pack?

Research shows late-night orders usually come from groups of two to four after studying or a night out. Batching those into one delivery keeps the per-drink price inside the $6.25–$8.15 range seen at nearby Westwood shops.

Prototype waitlist

Tell us you want this to exist

Leave your email and we will send a short survey about which dorm and which hours matter most. This is a waitlist and feedback form only — it does not place an order and does not sign you up for a live service.

Prototype waitlist — no payment, no order, no commitment. This page is a concept built for validation.

payload.markdown:
## What we built

Midnight Boba is a proposed late-night boba delivery pilot for UCLA students living on the Hill: orders are picked up from Westwood shops and handed off in the dorm lobby during late-night windows, instead of asking students to walk to Gayley or Broxton after the shops close.

## What we learned

- Nearby boba pricing sits between **$6.25 and $8.15 per drink**: Just Boba lists $6.25 Thai milk tea and $6.50 classic milk tea, while Le Phant is cited at $8.15 by the Daily Bruin.
- Late-night supply is thin: Sharetea is documented around 11am–12am, Just Boba runs to 11pm Mon–Thu and 12am Fri–Sun, Le Phant closes at 6–7pm and is closed Tue/Sat, and Milksha’s official page says 11am–9pm, so the research treats the 12am–3am window as effectively unserved except Just Boba on weekends.
- The real constraint is UCLA housing access: dorm guests must be signed in at access desks from 9pm–5am, so the service has to be a lobby handoff, not a room drop—and no competitor currently markets dorm-lobby delivery.

## Next 3 steps

- Validate pricing and demand by sending the waitlist survey to UCLA students and RAs, asking which dorm and which late-night hours matter most while checking real supply costs against the $6.25–$8.15 band.
- Book a domain and replace the prototype form with a real waitlist capture and inbox before any public push.
- Publish the launch kit across X, LinkedIn and Instagram, then send the three outreach emails to an RA, a club treasurer and a campus creator.

## Links

- [Midnight Boba waitlist landing page](https://subscriber-karma-assignments-lifestyle.trycloudflare.com/sites/run_4hN7Q1M-b-/)
- Scout UCLA late-night boba demand: competitor hours, pricing, audience and dorm-access research.
- Draft launch kit for UCLA boba delivery: three social posts and three outreach emails.
